title: Least-recently-used session cache
insight: LeetCode 146 LRU Cache: hash map plus doubly linked list for O(1) get, put and eviction
prompt: This module is our in-memory session cache. Implement the Cache type in cache.go so it behaves as README.md describes: fixed capacity, least-recently-used eviction, and constant-time operations. Keep the exported API and package name unchanged, use only the standard library, and make sure `go build ./...` and `go vet ./...` pass. Add tests if that helps you verify it.
